verdict.rationale: The only evidence is webhook-based: Helicone sends request-completion webhooks that users can use to "score responses" and run "real-time evaluation" for quality, safety, and relevance. That implies the ML engineer must build and host the judge logic externally. Nothing shows natively configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators. Missing for 10: built-in LLM-as-a-judge evaluator configuration (judge model, criteria, rubric), native score storage and display, evaluation against datasets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
